blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea—North Korea dismissed a UN atomic watchdog resolution that renewed demands to halt nuclear activities, state media reported Saturday. It said the resolution has “no effect” because Pyongyang is not a member of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). A foreign ministry statement on Friday accused “hostile forces” of seeking to bring an end to the country’s nuclear program during this week’s general conference of the IAEA, state news agency KCNA said. “Pitifully, the ‘resolution’ cooked up by the US and the West has no effect on the DPRK’s position as a nuclear weapons state,” a foreign ministry spokesperson said, […]...
